architectReview.evidence: Delegated architect review (agent 1-ReviewLocalFlow, opus) returned APPROVE with nothing blocking; all five acceptance criteria met: src/local reuses the Executor seam (for_kind + ExecCtx{llm:None}) with no parallel pipeline and no modality branching in the CLI/store; the deterministic backend path works with no cloud/API key; the exit-code contract is correct; JSON round-trips preserve unknown fields via serde flatten. It raised 1 MEDIUM (FLOW.md documented `test run --all`, which the CLI does not expose) plus 2 LOW nits (load/load_one used map_err(|_|), masking non-NotFound IO errors; a duplicated temp_root test helper). ALL THREE were fixed in this iteration: FLOW.md now shows `test run` (all)/`--id`; project::load and store::load_one branch on ErrorKind::NotFound for the friendly hint and propagate other IO errors with context; a shared #[cfg(test)] tmp_root() was hoisted into local/mod.rs. Post-fix reverification is green.

executorQa.evidence: Real local end-to-end against a live python http.server (artifacts/local-e2e.txt): project init -> test add (2 cases) -> test run. Red-team: a GET / expect-200 case PASSes while a GET /missing expect-200 case FAILs with the verbatim 'expected Some(200), got 404' (proves the validator discriminates rather than rubber-stamping); `test run` exits 1 on any failure and `test run --id <passing>` exits 0; results/<id>.json is written per test; running from a directory with no project.json prints the friendly 'no project.json ...; run testsprite-rs project init first' diagnostic. Unit: 6 new pure filesystem round-trip tests + 4 pre-existing = 10/10 green; cargo build clean; cargo clippy --all-targets 0 warnings.
e2eCommands: testsprite-rs project init --type backend --name e2e --url http://127.0.0.1:PORT
redTeamCommands: test run with a case expecting 200 on a path that 404s (must FAIL + exit 1)
test run from a directory without project.json (must error clearly)
